gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.worstzwijntje: Rarity: Uncommon (in the Mika Stable of the Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.worstzwijntje: A little bratwurst on four tiny legs, with a snout, two little tusks, a stripe of mustard down its back and a curly tail with a knot in it. The Mikas make it sniff out nibbles. Help the Stable Hand Guh and you get two of your own: pet, brush and feed them, and every day they sniff out something tasty for you. Oink, nyeg!
structure.guhs.mika_woonblokken.tooltip: The apartment blocks of the Nether Mikas: walkways, clotheslines and Granny Mika with her soup (Guhbarbecuether)
structure.guhs.mika_stal.tooltip: The stable of the Sausage Piglets, with the Stable Hand Guh in front of the big door (Guhbarbecuether)
structure.guhs.mika_brugpaleis.tooltip: A toll bridge through the mouth of a gigantic Mika. The Toll Keeper wants nibbles or riddles (Guhbarbecuether)
item.guhs.paleizen_omasoep.lore: From Granny Mika, for the grumps of the apartment block. Don't eat it yourself, nyeg!
item.guhs.paleizen_breiwerkje.lore: Half a little cap on two needles. Bring it back to Granny.
item.guhs.paleizen_zwijnenvoer.lore: For the feeding trough in the Mika Stable. (Tastes like cardboard.)
item.guhs.paleizen_gevangen_zwijntje.lor: The runaway Sausage Piglet. Bring him to the Stable Hand Guh.
Put the basket down (right-click the ground): out hops a Sausage Piglet that wants to live with you.
Petting, brushing and nibble feed: a happy Sausage Piglet sniffs out something tasty every day.
item.guhs.paleizen_losse_plank.lore: Right-click close to the gap in the toll bridge: you lay a whole row of planks.
item.guhs.paleizen_recept_brug.lore: With this blueprint in your crafting table you can make Mika Bridge Planks and Rope Railing.
item.guhs.paleizen_recept_brug.lore2: It simply stays in your crafting table. (The bridge is drawn crooked.)
gui.guhs.boerderij.blij.worstzwijntje: Your Sausage Piglet is happy as can be! It's off to sniff out something tasty for you.
gui.guhs.paleizen.snuffel: Sniff sniff... your Sausage Piglet has sniffed something out!
gui.guhs.paleizen.mandje.los: Oink! Your Sausage Piglet hops out of the basket.
gui.guhs.paleizen.mandje.geen_plek: There's no room for the basket here. Find a bit of open ground.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.hallo: Oh, a visitor! Come in, child... or no, better stay outside, there's yarn everywhere in here. I'm Granny Mika. Those young Mikas swipe nibbles all day long. Not me, mind you. I knit. And I cook sausage soup. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.vraag: Would you do something for me? My neighbors grumble all day long, and only one thing helps: a little bowl of my sausage soup. But my little paws won't take all those stairs anymore.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.uitleg: Grumble Mika lives downstairs in the west block and grumbles about the noise. Whiny Mika lives in the east block, two floors up, and whines about the smell. And Snore Mika, two floors below me, snores so loudly that he wakes himself up. And then he grumbles. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.soep: Thank you, child! Here are three little bowls: one for Grumble Mika, one for Whiny Mika and one for Snore Mika. Don't eat them yourself, now! ...Oh well. I've got a whole pot left.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.soep_nog: Has the soup gone around yet? %s grumps to go. Grumble Mika lives downstairs in the west block, Whiny Mika two floors up in the east block and Snore Mika two floors below me.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.soep_kwijt: Is the soup gone? Or... did you eat it yourself? Never mind, child. Here, a fresh little bowl.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.breiwerk: They've all eaten and nobody is grumbling? Such peace and quiet! Then I can finally get on with my knit... MY KNITTING! It was lying on the edge of the walkway. It blew away: I just saw it land on the roof of the low block. Would you fetch it for me?
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.breiwerk_nog: My knitting must still be on the roof garden of the low block, over there on the other side. Take the stairs in the east tower and walk along the walkway, child.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.klaar: My knitting! And not a single stitch dropped. You know what? This little cap was nearly done anyway... click click click... there! A Knitted Mika Cap for your guh. With little horns! And I'll tell the young Mikas to give you a discount when you barter. Or else no more soup for them. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.dank0: Will you drop by again? There's always soup on.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.dank1: That cap must look adorable on your guh. With little horns you look like a real Mika right away. But a sweet one.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.dank2: A Nether Mika won't give you a discount? Then just say: 'Granny will hear about this!' Nyeg.
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.hint.soep: bring the soup to Grumble Mika (west block, ground floor), Whiny Mika (east block, two floors up) and Snore Mika (tall block, two floors up)
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.hint.breiwerk: find the knitting basket on the roof garden of the low east block (the stairs in the east tower)
quest.guhs.paleizen.oma.hint.terug: bring the knitting to Granny Mika on the top walkway
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.0.mopper: Grumble! Always such a racket around here. Stomping paws on the walkway, bells ringing, piglets oinking. GRUMBLE!
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.0.soep: Grumble... is that Granny Mika's soup? ...Slurp. Hm. Well. It is pretty tasty. But don't tell anyone. Grumble.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.0.tevreden: Grumble. Quiet now, I'm still enjoying the soup.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.1.mopper: It STINKS in here! Of burnt nibbles, of wet Mika, of everything. And nobody does a thing about it!
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.1.soep: What's that I smell... sausage soup? From Granny? Give it here! ...Mmm. Okay. THIS is allowed to smell.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.1.tevreden: I'm not whining for a moment. My snout is still full of soup smell. Lovely.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.2.mopper: ZZZ... snore... HUH?! Who's waking me up? I was just asleep! Well, I woke up from my own snoring. But STILL.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.2.soep: Soup in bed? From Granny? ...Slurp slurp. It makes you so nice and sleepy. Nighty-night. ZZZ...
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.3.a: Nice weather for the laundry, eh? Well. It's always smoky here. But the laundry is up.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.3.b: Do you know Granny Mika from the top walkway? She knits socks for the whole block. They do itch, though.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.4.a: Barbecuing takes patience. And swiped nibbles. But you didn't hear that last bit from me.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.4.b: Sausage? Nah, just kidding. Those are mine.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.5.a: Shh. I'm sunbathing. Yes, I know there's no sun here. You just have to believe in it.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.5.b: This is the nicest roof in the whole Barbecuether. Especially when nobody talks to me.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.geen_soep: No soup, no knocking on my door. Grump grump.
quest.guhs.paleizen.mopper.vreemde: Soup? From whom? I don't take anything from strangers. Go talk to Granny Mika first. Grump.
gui.guhs.paleizen.soep.klaar: All three grumps have their soup. Suddenly it's very quiet in the block... Go tell Granny Mika!
gui.guhs.paleizen.breiwerk.niet_nu: A little basket with knitting. Whose could it be?
gui.guhs.paleizen.breiwerk.gevonden: You found Granny Mika's knitting! Quick, bring it back.
gui.guhs.paleizen.breiwerk.al: You already have the knitting. Granny Mika is waiting on the top walkway.
gui.guhs.paleizen.breiwerk.klaar: Granny left a spare bit of knitting here. 'For when it's windy again', she says.
gui.guhs.paleizen.korting: Granny Mika's discount! The Mika tosses your ingot back. 'Granny will hear about this!'
gui.guhs.paleizen.beloning.korting: Discount with the Nether Mikas: every third barter is free
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.hallo: Psst! You there! I'm the Stable Hand Guh. Yes, a guh, working for the Mikas. Somebody has to look after the Sausage Piglets, right? The Mikas make them sniff out nibbles all day and do nothing but shout. It makes them so restless, nyeg.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.vraag: Just look: they're bouncing around in their pens. Will you help me calm them down? All you have to do is pet them. Mikas can't do that, they don't have the patience.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.uitleg: A Sausage Piglet is a little sausage on legs: a snout, two little tusks, a stripe of mustard down its back and a curly tail with a knot in it. They can smell a nibble from a hundred blocks away. And they adore being petted. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.aai: Wahoog! Pet three of them until they oink calmly: three pets per piglet, and the bouncing settles all by itself. Empty hand, gentle paws.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.aai_nog: %s more Sausage Piglets to calm down. Take it easy: three pets per piglet, with an empty hand.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.voer: Hear that? Happy oinking! Now they're peckish. Here, a sack of piglet feed. Empty it into the feeding trough, all the way at the back of the aisle.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.voer_nog: The feeding trough is at the end of the aisle. Right-click it with the sack of piglet feed.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.voer_kwijt: Lost the sack? Here, I've got another one. Don't eat it yourself: it tastes like cardboard. Don't ask how I know.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.ontsnapt: Munch away! One, two, three, four, five... wait. Where's Oinky? His pen is open! OINKY HAS ESCAPED! He must be somewhere near the paddock. Sneak up to him, or he'll get spooked and run off. And then pick him up, nyeg!
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.zoek_nog: Oinky likes to hide behind the hay bales in the paddock, by the cart or up in the hayloft. Sneak, remember! Stomping paws spook him.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.klaar: OINKY! Come to your stable hand. You're a hero, nyeg! You know what? The Mikas never count their piglets anyway. Here: two little ones, each in a basket. Take good care of them: petting, brushing and nibble feed. Then every day they'll sniff out something tasty for you.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.dank0: How are your Sausage Piglets doing? Are they getting enough pets?
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.dank1: A happy Sausage Piglet sniffs something out every day. Sometimes a nibble, sometimes something from the Barbecuether. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.dank2: Don't tell the Mikas I give the piglets extra feed. Or soon I'll be the stable hand of... nothing.
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.hint.aai: pet three Sausage Piglets in the stable (empty hand, three pets per piglet)
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.hint.voer: right-click the feeding trough at the back of the aisle with the sack of piglet feed
quest.guhs.paleizen.stal.hint.zoek: look for Oinky near the paddock, sneak up to him and pick him up
gui.guhs.paleizen.aai.1: Oink? The Sausage Piglet is already bouncing a little less.
gui.guhs.paleizen.aai.2: Oinkkk... Almost calm. Just one more pet!
gui.guhs.paleizen.aai.3: Oinkkk! This Sausage Piglet is completely calm. (%s of 3)
gui.guhs.paleizen.aai.al: You already calmed this Sausage Piglet. It's oinking happily.
gui.guhs.paleizen.aai.klaar: Three calm Sausage Piglets! Go back to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.paleizen.voerbak: Munch munch munch! The Sausage Piglets dive into the feed. Go back to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.paleizen.schrik: Your stomping spooks Oinky and he runs off! Sneak up to him next time.
gui.guhs.paleizen.moe: Oinky is tired from all the running. Now you can just pick him up.
gui.guhs.paleizen.gevangen: You've got Oinky! He's oinking softly in your arms. Bring him to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.paleizen.niet_van_jou: This is the runaway piglet of %s. Yours is somewhere else.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.hallo: HALT! This is the toll bridge of the Mika Bridge Palace and I am the Toll Keeper. Nobody gets through my mouth... er, through THE mouth, without paying toll. Eight cheese nibbles. Or, if you think you're clever: three riddles. Nyeg nyeg nyeg.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.tol_tekort: Eight cheese nibbles, I said. You have %s. I can count, you know, nyeg. Or try the riddles instead.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.tol_betaald: Eight nibbles! Clink clank, into the piggy bank. You may pass.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel_fout: WRONG! Nyeg nyeg nyeg! Have another good think. I've got plenty more.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsels_klaar: Three right?! Who told you the answers... Oh well. A deal is a deal. You may pass.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.brug: But er... there's one tiny thing. The bridge is broken. Again. The planks keep falling out, can you believe it? Here: five new planks. Could you pop them in? I'm far too busy toll keeping.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.brug_nog: The planks go in the gap, past my toll house. %s rows to go. Did you fall in? There's a scaffold hanging under the gap, with a ladder back up.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.brug_kwijt: Lost the planks? Dropped them in the sauce, I bet. Here, I've got more. I ALWAYS have more.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.brug_wacht: Somebody else just fixed the bridge. Just wait a bit: it'll collapse again any moment. Mika Quality!
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.bel_nog: The bridge is whole? Then ring the toll bell in the bell tower on the other side. Then everybody knows the bridge is open again. And that there's toll to collect again!
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.klaar: DONG! I heard it all the way over here. Nice work. All right then: you never pay toll on my bridge again. And here, the blueprint of the bridge, with some planks and rope railing. You can build your own bridge at home. Without a toll. A shame, but oh well.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.dank0: Free passage for you. But don't tell the others, or soon everybody will want it.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.dank1: The bridge collapsed again? Yes. It does that. That's what makes it a Mika bridge.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.dank2: Want another riddle? What's yellow and costs eight nibbles? ...Nothing. I just want eight nibbles.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.tekening_kwijt: Lost the blueprint? Here's a new one. I draw them myself. That's why the bridge is drawn crooked.
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.optie.tol: I'll pay the toll (8 cheese nibbles)
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.hint.brug: lay the five planks in the gap in the bridge (right-click with a plank, close to the gap)
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.hint.bel: walk across the bridge to the bell tower and ring the toll bell
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.hint.terug: go back to the Toll Keeper Mika for your reward
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.halt: Whoa whoa! First pay the toll or guess three riddles, nyeg!
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.plank: Tap tap tap! %s rows of planks to go.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.plank.op: You're out of planks, but %s rows are still missing. Get new planks from the Toll Keeper Mika.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.plank.ver: Walk to the gap in the toll bridge to lay this plank.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.plank.heel: The bridge is already whole. Wait until it collapses again (Mika Quality).
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.plank.niet_nu: These planks are for the toll bridge. Talk to the Toll Keeper Mika first.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.brug_heel: The bridge is whole! Hurry to the bell tower and ring the toll bell, before it collapses again.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.bel: DONG! The toll bell echoes across the whole bridge. Go back to the Toll Keeper Mika.
gui.guhs.paleizen.tol.bel.niet_nu: Dong. Nice sound. But the Toll Keeper has no idea what's going on: talk to him first.
gui.guhs.paleizen.beloning.doorgang: Free passage across the toll bridge, forever
gui.guhs.paleizen.beloning.zwijntjes: Two Sausage Piglets in a basket (to take home)
gui.guhs.paleizen.nodig.tol: Cheese nibbles for the toll (or guess three riddles)
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.0: It's yellow, it crunches and it's always gone too soon. What is it?
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.1: I have a curly tail with a knot in it, four little legs, and really I'm a sausage. Who am I?
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.2: What gets wetter the more it dries?
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.3: What has a mouth but doesn't bite, and you walk right through it?
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.4: What can you break without touching it?
quest.guhs.paleizen.tol.raadsel.5: What does a guh say when it totally agrees with you?
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.uitleg: Granny Mika doesn't join in the nibble swiping: she knits and cooks sausage soup for the whole block. But her neighbors grumble and her knitting has blown away. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.0: Climb to the top walkway of the tall block and talk to Granny Mika.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.waar.0: The Mika Apartments in the Guhbarbecuether (Super Compass: Barbecue)
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.1: Bring a little bowl of sausage soup to Grumble Mika, Whiny Mika and Snore Mika (right-click them with the soup in your hand).
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.waar.1: Grumble Mika: west block, ground floor. Whiny Mika: east block, two floors up. Snore Mika: tall block, two floors up
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.2: Granny Mika's knitting has blown off the walkway. Find the knitting basket and take the knitting (right-click).
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.waar.2: The roof garden of the low east block (take the stairs in the east tower)
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.3: Bring the knitting to Granny Mika.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.waar.3: The top walkway of the tall block
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.klaar: Granny Mika is knitting again and the whole block smells of soup. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.nu.1_klaar: All three grumps have their soup and suddenly it's very quiet in the block. Go tell Granny Mika!
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.waar.1_klaar: The top walkway of the tall block
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.kort.0: Talk to Granny Mika on the top walkway
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.kort.1: Bring soup to the three grumps
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.kort.1_klaar: Tell Granny Mika the soup has gone around
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.kort.2: Find the knitting on the roof garden
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_oma.kort.3: Bring the knitting to Granny Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.uitleg: The Mikas make their Sausage Piglets sniff out nibbles all day and are far too rough. The Stable Hand Guh secretly takes good care of them, but now they're bouncing around in their pens and one has escaped.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.stap.0: Talk to the Stable Hand Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.0: Talk to the Stable Hand Guh in front of the big stable door.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.0: The Mika Stable in the Guhbarbecuether (Super Compass: Barbecue)
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.1: Pet three restless Sausage Piglets until they oink calmly: right-click with an empty hand, three pets per piglet.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.1: In the pens of the stable and in the paddock
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.2: Empty the Stable Hand Guh's sack of piglet feed into the feeding trough (right-click the trough with the sack).
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.2: At the end of the aisle in the stable
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.3: Oinky has escaped! Look for him near the stable, sneak up to him (or he gets spooked) and pick him up (right-click).
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.3: Behind the hay bales in the paddock, in the hayloft or by the cart
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.klaar: All the Sausage Piglets are oinking happily, and you have two of your own. Oink, nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.1_klaar: Three calm Sausage Piglets! Go back to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.1_klaa: In front of the big stable door
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.2_klaar: The Sausage Piglets are munching happily. Go back to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.2_klaa: In front of the big stable door
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.nu.3_gevang: You have Oinky in your arms! Bring him to the Stable Hand Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.waar.3_geva: In front of the big stable door
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.kort.0: Talk to the Stable Hand Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.kort.1_klaa: Go back to the Stable Hand Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.kort.2: Fill the feeding trough in the stable
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.kort.2_klaa: Go back to the Stable Hand Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.stalknecht.kort.3_geva: Bring Oinky to the Stable Hand Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.naam: The Toll Bridge of the Mika Bridge Palace
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.uitleg: Nobody crosses the bridge without paying toll or guessing three riddles. And the bridge itself? Broken again. Mika Quality, nyeg.
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.stap.0: Talk to the Toll Keeper Mika
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.stap.1: Pay toll or guess three riddles
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.0: Walk to the gigantic Mika mouth and talk to the Toll Keeper Mika.
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.waar.0: The Mika Bridge Palace in the Guhbarbecuether (Super Compass: Barbecue)
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.1: Pay a toll of 8 cheese nibbles, or get three of the Toll Keeper Mika's riddles right.
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.waar.1: With the Toll Keeper Mika in the gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.2: Lay the Toll Keeper's five bridge planks in the gap (right-click with a plank, close to the gap).
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.waar.2: On the bridge, past the toll house
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.3: Walk across the repaired bridge to the bell tower and ring the toll bell (right-click the bell).
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.waar.3: In the bell tower on the other side
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.4: Go back to the Toll Keeper Mika for your reward.
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.waar.4: With the Toll Keeper Mika in the gate
gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.nu.klaar: The bridge is whole (for now), the bell is ringing and you may always cross for free. Wahoog!

gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.kort.1: Pay toll or guess three riddles

gui.guhs.verhalen.tolwachter.kort.3: Ring the toll bell on the other side

advancements.guhs.barbecuether.paleizen_: Bring Granny Mika's soup to the grumps and find her knitting
Calm the Sausage Piglets, fill the feeding trough and catch Oinky
Pay toll or guess the riddles, repair the bridge and ring the toll bell
